## Add human gene symbols to the annotation 

code from https://www.r-bloggers.com/converting-mouse-to-human-gene-names-with-biomart-package/

```{r, eval = FALSE}
musGenes <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3$mgi_symbol
 
# Basic function to convert mouse to human gene names
convertMouseGeneList <- function(x){
 
require("biomaRt")
human = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
mouse = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
 
genesV2 = getLDS(attributes = c("mgi_symbol"), filters = "mgi_symbol", values = x , mart = mouse, attributesL = c("hgnc_symbol"), martL = human, uniqueRows=FALSE)
human <- unique(genesV2[, 2])
 
# Print the first 6 genes found to the screen
print(head(humanx))
return(genesV2)
}
mgi_to_hngc_symbol <- convertMouseGeneList(musGenes)
head(mgi_to_hngc_symbol)
```

Our GNP specific transcripts are a bit of a nightmare to getting human orthologs because some of the names are ensembl transcript id and others were only described in UCSC.   

Our tables are currently indexed by  ensembl transcript id, would optimal if we could maintain that in the human tables  

```{r, eval = TRUE}
human = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
listAttributes(human)
possible_attrib <- listAttributes(human)
possible_attrib[grep( "hsapiens", possible_attrib$name),]

attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_transcript_id", "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene", "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_peptide", "mmusculus_homolog_orthology_type", "mmusculus_homolog_canonical_transcript_protein", "mmusculus_homolog_perc_id")
```


listAttributes(mouse)
possible_attrib <- listAttributes(mouse)
possible_attrib[grep( "hsapien", possible_attrib$name),]

orth.mouse = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE)
dim(orth.mouse)

length(unique(orth.mouse$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene))
orth.mouse.filt = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE, filters="with_mmusculus_homolog")
dim(orth.mouse.filt)
length(unique(orth.mouse.filt$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene))
attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","hgnc_symbol")
human_HGNC = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE) 

orth.mouse.filt <- merge(x = orth.mouse.filt, y= human_HGNC, by.x = 1, by.y  = 1, all.x = TRUE)
colnames(orth.mouse.filt)[1] <- "hg_ensembl_gene_id"
```

test <- merge(x =histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3, y = mgi_to_hngc_symbol, by.x = "mgi_symbol", by.y =  "MGI.symbol", all.x = TRUE)
histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc_full <- merge(x =histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3, y = orth.mouse.filt, by.x = "ensembl_gene_id", by.y =  "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene", all.x = TRUE)
dim(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3)
dim(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc)

histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc  <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc_full %>% 
  dplyr::filter((!(is.na(hgnc_symbol))  &  (diff_group != "other"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(hg_ensembl_gene_id,hgnc_symbol,diff_group)

histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc <- histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc[!duplicated(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc$hg_ensembl_gene_id),]
table(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc$hgnc_symbol == "")
histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc$hgnc_symbol[histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc$hgnc_symbol == ""] <- NA

write.table(histone_k_toc_t50_k27me3_hgnc, "~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/h3k27me3_groups_hgnc_symbol.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
